report.incident_summary: The user reports that EC2 CPU utilization is above 90%. Metrics show CPU utilization above 90% for three out of four samples, while memory utilization remains below the threshold.

severity_rationale.statement: CPU utilization is above the 90% threshold for three out of four samples, indicating potential resource saturation.

potential_root_causes.statement: The high CPU utilization could be due to an increased workload or inefficient processes running on the instance.
There could be a misconfiguration or an unexpected spike in traffic causing the high CPU usage.

uncertainty: Service impact and SLOs are unknown.
Memory utilization is within acceptable limits, suggesting the issue may be specific to CPU usage.
No other metrics or logs are available to confirm the root cause.
recommended_steps: Review recent changes to the workload or application code that could have increased CPU usage.
Check for any misconfigurations or unexpected traffic spikes that could be causing the high CPU utilization.
Consider scaling the instance or optimizing the processes to better utilize the available resources.
additional_information_required: More detailed logs or metrics from the application running on the instance.
Information on recent changes to the workload or application code.
Details on any recent changes to the instance configuration or network traffic.
